svg.aria-label: How QualityLayer fits together: on your computer, your agent runs the QualityLayer CLI, which keeps each task in Markdown files in your repository, and the QualityLayer App reads the same files; only encrypted plans, comments and asks go to the QualityLayer Server at qualitylayer.dev, for your team and for people with a share link
